description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Include class, which handles the compilation of the {include} tag in Smarty templates. It defines how include statements are parsed and converted into PHP code, including resource handling, caching logic, and inline template compilation.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Include
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling {include} tags within Smarty templates, managing resource parsing, caching, scope, and inline sub-template compilation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Main method that generates PHP code for the {include} Smarty tag based on provided attributes, handling resource resolution, caching, scope, and variable assignment.

methods.name: compileInlineTemplate
methods.description: Helper method that compiles inline sub-templates, generating PHP functions for inline template rendering and caching them for reuse.
